classification: informational - community/lab-anchored serving recipe, never a CONTRACT acceptance floor

model.revision_policy: pinned at fetch time by fetch-model.sh (recorded in models/<key>/REVISION.txt and the manifest); set a hash here once a first good run is recorded
model.license: Qwen (Apache-2.0 family; verify on the model card at fetch time)
model.notes: official Qwen FP8 (block-128, dynamic activation scales); sparse MoE 35B total / ~3B active (256 experts, 8 routed + 1 shared); hybrid GatedDeltaNet attention; native 262,144 context; multimodal (disabled in our serve args)

engine.name: vllm
engine.version_policy: exact - the engine version recorded on the anchor runs

serve.notes: argv pattern from the published B200 run snapshot (LocalMaxxing), adapted: host pinned to loopback, port ours, GPU_UTIL 0.90 matches both the snapshot and our <=0.90 conservative rule. max-model-len 32768 is deliberate: it keeps the KV cache comfortably inside the 64 GB unlock at this batch size on a passively-cooled card at 180 W; the long-context anchors (16k/64k) were measured on other setups at 300 W and are context-only - not reachable from these argv

benchmark.protocol: vendor live_benchmark.py (usage-token-counted-v1) - the same three cases as the acceptance recipe
benchmark.comparability_note: the anchors below were measured at DIFFERENT prompt shapes (short-context single-stream; 16k/64k coding corpus) - our decode256/900/prefill numbers are for cross-model and cross-card comparison within OUR protocol only, and are NOT comparable to the anchor tok/s figures

long_context.config: vLLM, 300 W, speculation off, coding-style prompts
long_context.label: third-party lab sweep (it-still-boots.github.io, 1,603 decode points)

anchors.headline: FP8 fits comfortably (33.5 GB weights, ~30 GB KV headroom) but W4A16 paths of the same class outperform it on this card at long context

cautions: GA100 has FP8 tensor cores but the FP8 path is NOT the fastest on this card: W4A16 paths of the same 35B-class reached ~228 tok/s @16k in the same lab sweep
KV cache: 10 KiB/token with fp8 KV, 20 KiB/token bf16 (sizing for long context)
thermal: sustained decode on the passively-cooled card throttles without forced airflow - the fail-closed guard stops the smoke at 80/85 C
the 355.7 short-context figure is a self-report; the lab long-context numbers (154/136) are the realistic sustained expectation
PCIe Gen2 x4: model load of 33.5 GB takes minutes - not a failure

engine pin is vllm-ONLY (unlike the acceptance recipe's verify_versions lock): torch/transformers/flashinfer float with vllm's deps, so informational numbers are not auditable across engine micro-versions - re-pin a verify_versions block if cross-session auditability is ever needed
